answers.question: How does Reconciliation work in O(n) time?
answers.answer: Comparing two generic trees is O(n^3). React uses two heuristics to make it O(n): 1. Two elements of different types will produce different trees (React tears down the old tree immediately). 2. Developers can hint at which child elements may be stable across different renders with a `key` prop.

answers.question: RSC vs SSR?
answers.answer: SSR (Server-Side Rendering) renders your components to an HTML string on the server, sends it to the browser, and then 'hydrates' the page by downloading the JS bundle. React Server Components NEVER download their JS bundle to the browser. They remain exclusively on the server, sending only a serialized JSON UI representation to the client, drastically reducing bundle size.
